name: Aiming for Heaven by Serving in Hell
source:
When life ends, your soul journeys to Heaven or Hell.

To reach the gates of Heaven and to redeem your tainted soul, you must serve the demon goddess herself, Ironmouse.

Each step inches you closer to redemption or eternal damnation. Choose wisely, as the fate of your soul hangs in the balance.

Will you rise above the darkness and claim your place among the heavens? Or will you fail and be stuck in Hell forever?

[from [url=https://beatricealfbern.itch.io/aiming-for-heaven-by-serving-in-hell]itch.io[/url]]
